summary: M8 remains within the intended no-second-loop boundary, but its frozen contract has two blocking authority contradictions: it overstates startContinuable inbox admission as durable initial-message persistence, and its raw string child-id API conflicts with M5's JSON-safe global checkpoint semantics.
steps: Read the current AGENTS boundary and the English-authoritative M8 architecture and delivery contract on Issue #39's contract commit.

Compared the claimed spawn/follow-up/report lifecycle with installed @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent@0.1.1-rc.2 declarations and the current official upstream authority at 7169660d330452d32c91bb2e4788a9b8c2f83a18.
Traced the returned child-id value through existing M5 snapshot rules rather than treating it as isolated prose.

evidence.target: installed rc.2 SubagentRuntime.startContinuable authority versus M8 spawn success wording
evidence.note: index.d.ts and continuation.d.ts state that startContinuable resolves when the child's inbox accepts the prompt without waiting for the turn to start or for the message to reach the Session log. The M8 text instead says spawn succeeds only after DSH durably accepts the initial inbox message. The contract must distinguish accepted inbox admission from later log/persistence observation and cover the accepted-but-unlogged loss window.

evidence.target: M8 raw opaque child-id API versus existing M5 checkpoint ownership
evidence.note: M8 says rlm_spawn returns an opaque child Session id and M5 never serializes child ids. Existing RlmKernel._checkpoint serializes ordinary JSON-safe user globals; `handle = await rlm_spawn(...)` would make a returned string checkpoint-eligible. The contract must freeze a non-snapshottable Session-local capability or an equally explicit prevention/clearing rule before implementation, so restored Python cannot retain an id or authority.

The candidate otherwise keeps creation, FIFO admission, report routing, and settlement under the official continuable manager; it introduces no proposed plugin queue, scheduler, Service, Storage Domain, Task, or second Agent loop.
The selected checkout and upstream master both resolved to 7169660d330452d32c91bb2e4788a9b8c2f83a18.

limitations: Read-only contract review only; no source, test, Profile, model, CI, or external state was modified. The sole write is this append-only Issue #39 review record.
The two findings require contract correction before M8 RED or implementation. A successor contract re-review is required after the authority and M5 handle model are frozen.
